messages:
maya: quick q — i'm OOO next wed/thurs. can we rotate next week's triage lead? i'm currently on the calendar for the 10am slot.
josh: sure, we can swap. who wants to take the bug queue + owner assignment next week?
thomas: i can take it for the 10th. want me to own backlog grooming too?
maya: that would be awesome, thanks thomas. main ask: please run the 10–20 min owner walk through, assign unresolved bugs, and flag any blockers.
sara: fyi i'm running an RFC review at the same time — can we trim triage to 30m next week so i don't clash?
alex: 30m works. propose agenda: 1) quick backlog triage (10m) 2) bug queue owner assignments (10m) 3) quick RFC handoff / urgent PRs (10m)
maya: perfect. also want to add a small agenda tweak: add a short "hotfix readiness" check (1–2 mins) after owner assigns — helps with prod rollouts.
josh: +1 to that. also can triage-bot post the active bug list in #eng before the call so thomas has context?
triage-bot: scheduled post: "Active bug queue snapshot" will be posted to #eng at 09:45 on 2024-05-10. Use `!snapshot` to trigger ad-hoc.
thomas: thanks — i'll take the snapshot if triage-bot didn't. can someone tag the folks with the oldest assigned bugs so we can re-evaluate ownership?
sara: i'll tag in the thread now: @alex @josh @maya
alex: ack — i'll reassign anything >7d to myself for next-week triage handoff if it's unowned.
josh: small process ask: can we make the owner assignment step explicit in meeting notes? e.g., add a line `Owner:` next to each bug number so it's clear.
maya: yes please. thomas — could you record a 1–2 line note per bug in the doc? we can copy to the ticket.
thomas: yep i'll do that.
sara: one more: for RFC reviews, can we allocate explicit reviewers ahead of time? i'll drop a table in the doc so people can claim.
maya: sounds good. final check — does everyone agree to swap leads (maya -> thomas), shorten to 30m, and add hotfix check?
josh: :+1:
alex: :thumbsup:
thomas: sgtm
sara: ok by me
maya: thanks all. i'll update the calendar event title to "Triage (30m) — thomas lead" and add the agenda bullet list. ping me if anything else.
triage-bot: event updated: "Triage (30m) — thomas lead" on 2024-05-10 10:00. Reminder 15m before.
maya: leaving a quick checklist in the doc: `- snapshot posted @09:45` `- owner lines added` `- hotfix check` — thomas, can you confirm after the call?
thomas: will confirm and post minutes in #eng within 2 hours after meeting.
josh: awesome, thanks team.
